rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something secretly or without being noticed.

example.english: I ate the bag of chips in the drawer surreptitiously.
example.traditional: 我偷偷哋食咗櫃桶入面嗰包薯片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau1 tau1 dei2 sik6 zo2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6 go2 baau1 syu4 pin2

rows.note: Use this when the stealthy action also looks suspicious or furtive.

example.english: The stranger was looking around the back alley surreptitiously.
example.traditional: 個陌生人鬼鬼祟祟咁喺後巷周圍望。
example.jyutping: go3 mak6 sang1 jan4 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 hai2 hau6 hong2 zau1 wai4 mong6

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts for secretly doing or arranging something.

example.english: The company arranged an investigation surreptitiously.
example.traditional: 公司暗中安排人調查件事。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 am3 zung1 on1 paai4 jan4 diu6 caa4 gin6 si6
